units.source_text: 后来他教侍女长传话给前斋宫说：“那么这首诗如何回答呢？

en.t: Later he had the head gentlewoman send word to the former Ise priestess, saying, "Then how will you answer this poem?

units.source_text: 大概还有信吧，写的是什么？”

en.t: There is probably a letter too; what does it say?"

units.source_text: 前斋宫认为有所不便，没有把信给他看。

en.t: The former Ise priestess felt it would be awkward and did not show him the letter.

units.source_text: 她心中懊恼，很不高兴作复。

en.t: She was troubled at heart and had little desire to reply.

units.source_text: 众侍女劝道：“若不作复，太不知情，而且对不起朱雀爷。”

en.t: The gentlewomen urged her, "If you do not answer, it will seem terribly cold, and it would be discourteous to Lord Suzaku."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣听见了，也说：“不作复的确不好。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, heard this and also said, "It really would not be right to leave it unanswered.

units.source_text: 略微表示一点，也就算了。”

en.t: If you show just a little feeling, that will be enough."
The former Ise priestess felt deeply embarrassed.

units.source_text: 她回想昔年下伊势时情状，记得朱雀院容貌十分清秀，为了惜别而伤心饮泣。

en.t: She remembered the time long ago when she went down to Ise, and recalled how refined Suzaku had looked as he wept sadly at their parting.

units.source_text: 那时她年纪还小，童心中无端地觉得恋恋不舍。

en.t: She had still been young then, yet even in her childish heart she had somehow felt reluctant to leave him.

units.source_text: 往事如在目前，深为感慨，不禁回想起亡母六条妃子在世时种种情状来。

en.t: The past seemed to stand before her eyes, filling her with deep emotion, and she could not help recalling many things from the days when her late mother, Lady Rokujo, was still alive.
She replied only with a short poem:
